definitions.explanation: The act of solving puzzles, riddles, or mysteries. Also used for the genre of entertainment based on solving puzzles.

examples.japanese: なぞ{解|と}き⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦{探偵|たんてい}→探偵：07033_tantei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧なぞ{解|と}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑|いど}む→挑む：12708_idomu⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched a movie where a detective tackles solving a mystery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧なぞ{解|と}き⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: I participated in a puzzle-solving event with friends.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧なぞ{解|と}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。
examples.english: The final mystery-solving scene in this novel is the most interesting part.

notes:
Composed of なぞ (riddle, mystery) + {解|と}き (solving, from ⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧). Can also be written as {謎解|なぞと}き with kanji. The word covers a broad range from children's riddles to elaborate escape rooms and detective fiction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- なぞ{解|と}き⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧: puzzle-solving game
- なぞ{解|と}き⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧: puzzle-solving event
- なぞ{解|と}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}する→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧: take on a puzzle challenge
- なぞ{解|と}き⟦{脱出|だっしゅつ}→脱出：13934_dasshutsu⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧: escape room game

CULTURAL NOTE:
Puzzle-solving entertainment has become extremely popular in Japan. {謎解|なぞと}き⟦{脱出|だっしゅつ}→脱出：13934_dasshutsu⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧ (escape room games) are a major form of group entertainment, with venues in most cities. TV shows and manga also feature なぞ{解|と}き as a core element, especially in the detective genre.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{推理|すいり}→推理：18951_suiri⟧: deduction, reasoning (more detective/logical)
- ⟦パズル→パズル：05417_pazuru⟧: puzzle (borrowed English word, often for jigsaw or logic puzzles)
- ⟦クイズ→クイズ：10804_kuizu⟧: quiz (knowledge-based questions rather than mystery-solving)
